scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @bughunter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @bughunter/content build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bughunter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @bughunter/content build && pnpm -r test
